<!--
Measured, not read, in typst's document mode, whose 14pt leading sets its
lines 22pt apart.

The first paragraph after a heading is preceded by a spacer that
formattypst.lua takes back by the paragraph spacing. That was a fixed 18pt,
4pt more than this mode's, and set the paragraph 18pt under the heading
instead of 22pt.

A block quotation is indented half an inch on the left and not at all on
the right, as in every mode (journal mode indents 16pt). The body is
justified here, so a full line of body text and a full line of the
quotation both end at the margin.
-->

Alphaone alphatwo.

# Headone

Gammaone gammatwo.

> Quoteone words of a quotation long enough that it has to run on to several lines, so that its full lines can be measured from end to end against the text block, quotelast.

Bodyone words of a body paragraph long enough that it has to run on to several lines, so that its full lines can be measured from end to end against the text block, bodylast.
